text: E a anndaa an Nulaaɗo, fii yoga e sahaabaaɓe maa lamndiiɓe yo jihaadi farle e maɓɓe, ɓe wi'anaa ado jihaadi ndin farleede : "Nantee juuɗe mon ɗen e jihaadi, ñiiɓnon julde, jonnon asakal", nde ɓe ferunoo Madiina, lislaamu on heɓi doole, jihaadi ndin farlaa ; ɗum tedditiri ɓe, ɓe waɗti hulirde yim- ɓe ɓen wano ɓe hulirta non Alla, maa ko ɓuri ngol kulol tiiɗude, ɓe wi'i : "Joomi amen, ko Farlanɗaa hare e dow amen ? Hanno Nennanaa men haa men dakmitora aduna ? Maakan ɓe an Nulaaɗo: "Dakamme aduna ko juuti woo lannay, ko laakara ɓuri moƴƴannde on hulɗo Alla Toowuɗo On ; tawde ko ton neema duumotoo, on ɗuytaŋtaake golle mon moƴƴe yeru hufol tamaroore".
